item.title: Eco Wave Power Completes Feasibility Study for Wave Energy Project at Port of Ngqura
item.description: Eco Wave Power Global AB (Eco Wave Power) a leading onshore wave energy technology company, announced the successful completion of a feasibility study for a potential wave energy power station at the Port of Ngqura, South Africa.

item.title: Nauticus Robotics, Inc. Announces Major Leadership Enhancements, Aquanaut Manufacturing Expansion, and Accelerated Growth Strategy
item.description: Nauticus Robotics, Inc. (Nauticus), a pioneer in autonomous subsea robotics and AI-driven offshore solutions, announced a series of strategic leadership appointments and commercialization initiatives designed to accelerate product growth, expand manufacturing capacity, and position the Company for its next phase of scale.

item.title: DOF Group Announces Offshore Operations Contract Award in Argentina
item.description: DOF Group ASA (DOF) has announced the award of a Substantial contract for a project in Argentina. The project is scheduled for offshore operations across two campaigns in Q2 and Q3-Q4 of 2026 and will encompass mooring pre-lay, pipeline end manifold installation/construction management, tie-in spools installation, hook-up and pre-commissioning of two CALM buoys, and diving services. item.title: BOEM Proposes Third Gulf of America Lease Sale
item.description: The Bureau of Ocean Energy Management announced a Proposed Notice of Sale for the third offshore oil and gas lease sale under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act. The proposed lease sale, known as Lease Sale Big Beautiful Gulf 3, or BBG3, is scheduled to take place on Aug. 12, 2026.

item.title: Japanese Deep-Sea Mining Expedition Returns with Rare Earth Mud
item.description: In the first week of February 2026, the Japanese government reported that it had successfully carried out the retrieval of deep-sea mud samples that could be key to unlocking access to rare-earth metals like yttrium, europium, terbium, and dysprosium in quantities sufficient to satisfy supply chain needs for decades.

item.title: Cardona Marine Group Launches New Class of Drones
item.description: Cardona Marine Group, Inc., a defense maritime startup, announced the unveiling of a New Class of Drones, “Stealth Maritime Attachment Drones” and their version the SP- 7V2, (Sea-Predator 7, version 2). This next-generation prototype in development is virtually undetectable both above and below the surface and can attach to the bottom of most any ship or submarine in stealth using the CMG Multi-Vessel Attachment System (MVAS).

item.title: Hanwha Ocean Signs Landmark Agreements to Strengthen Canada’s Sovereign Defense Industrial Capacity
item.description: Hanwha Ocean and Ontario Shipyards have signed a strategic Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to accelerate the return of large-scale shipbuilding in Ontario and to strengthen Canada’s ability to deliver future naval programs.

item.title: Partners to Collaborate on the Development Unmanned and Hybrid Maritime Platforms
item.description: HAVELSAN, Piloda Defence, and VN Maritime have signed a strategic Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to collaborate on the development, integration and commercialization of unmanned and hybrid (manned–unmanned) maritime platforms tailored for the Italian market.

item.title: Investment to Expand Tidal Energy R&D Infrastructure in Scotland
item.description: Tidal energy testing will be expanded in Orkney—cementing Scotland’s place as a clean energy superpower and unlocking greener power for communities.
